result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible viewport and carousel clipping issues that make content appear cut off.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the second restaurant card, obscuring its lower content and making the card appear abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the page scroll position does not leave important card content behind the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels show partially clipped items at the right edge, including a partial category pill and truncated restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Add a little trailing padding and/or a subtle carousel affordance so the clipping reads as intentional horizontal scrolling rather than an accidental layout overflow.
